answer_1.quote: Annotation is initiated by a pre-selected but editable seed topic... which the LLM uses to generate up to 5 Question nodes... The user can then pick a question that interests her, or clarify through edits, or write her own.
datasets: CULTURE CARTOGRAPHY dataset for Nigeria and Indonesia
answer_1.outputs: Cultural Q&A trees with questions and answers

answer_2.quote: compute the Recall@K R@K = |{gold answers} ∩ {model answers @K}| / |{gold answers}|

answer_3.quote: rely on LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations with GPT-4o to compute the Recall@K... Does any part of {model answers @K} contain the same information as the {gold answer}?

answer_4.quote: annotators scored the AI answers for quality on the same 0-3 Likert Scale... CULTURE EXPLORER asks users to score AI answers on a 0-3 Likert Scale
answer_4.guideline: Score AI answers 0-3 for relevance and personal applicability
